headline: AAP Rules Out Congress from Alliance
summary: The Aam Aadmi Party has excluded the Congress from the 'Goa First' alliance. AAP has urged its ally, the Goa Forward Party, to clarify its official stance.

headline: AAP Alleges Conspiracy to Break Alliance
summary: With the 2027 polls in mind, AAP has alleged that there are attempts to fracture the 'Goa First' alliance. The party has asked the Goa Forward Party to clarify its position.

headline: AAP Targets BJP and Congress Over Defections
summary: AAP has criticized both the BJP and Congress over political defections in Goa. The party has also questioned the silence and position of the Goa Forward Party chief.

headline: Soham, Simran Win Big at GFA Awards
summary: Soham and Simran emerged as key winners at the Goa Football Association's grand Awards Night. The event celebrated outstanding achievements in Goan football.

headline: GFA Celebrates Goa's Footballing Stars
summary: The Goa Football Association hosted its annual Awards Night to honour the top-performing players and contributors in the sport. The ceremony showcased the state's best footballing talent.

headline: AIFF-Club Relations Face New Challenges
summary: The delicate relationship between the All India Football Federation and domestic clubs is facing another difficult test. Key issues continue to strain coordination between both parties.

headline: Teachers Instructed to Pass Eligibility Test
summary: The state education department has mandated that school teachers with more than five years of remaining service must clear the Teacher Eligibility Test. Failure to do so could affect their employment status.

headline: Dempo College Shines at Yuva Tourism Meet
summary: Students from Dempo College performed exceptionally well at the Goa Yuva Tourism Meet. The event aimed at promoting tourism-centric ideas and skills among the youth.

headline: Rosary College Organises 'Impressions '26'
summary: Rosary College of Commerce and Arts recently hosted its popular annual event, 'Impressions '26'. The student festival witnessed enthusiastic participation across various competitions.

headline: Goa Taxi Fares Set to Rise
summary: Commuters and tourists in Goa will have to pay more as taxi fares are set to increase. The government is planning a revised fare structure to address operators' concerns.

headline: Creators to Map Goa's Progress Under 'Impact Drive'
summary: A group of digital content creators will travel across Goa to document positive community transformations. The initiative, called 'Impact Drive', aims to highlight developmental progress.

headline: Goa Airports Record 11.5 Million Passengers
summary: Goa's airports successfully managed 11.5 million passengers during the 2025-26 financial year. The newly operational Mopa airport contributed significantly to this robust growth.

headline: Vande Bharat Train May Connect Goa and Bengaluru
summary: A new Vande Bharat Express route is being planned to connect Goa and Bengaluru directly. The proposed high-speed train will make 14 major stops along its journey.

headline: Catholic Association Flags Concerns Over FCRA Bill
summary: The Catholic Association of Goa has stated that the proposed FCRA Bill will unfairly affect minority-run institutions. They warn that the legislation could restrict essential welfare funding.

headline: Congress Leader Slams Goa Government on Governance
summary: Congress spokesperson Pawan Khera has accused the Goa government of failing the state's youth and delivering poor governance. He criticized the lack of job opportunities and development.

headline: Sameera Reddy Shares Warm Family Moment from Goa
summary: Actress Sameera Reddy has shared a delightful, candid video capturing a sweet mother-son moment during her Goan vacation. The social media post quickly garnered warm responses from fans.

headline: Voters Left Out of Revision List, Says HC
summary: The Bombay High Court's Goa bench has observed that many local voters are trapped in a catch-22 situation after being left out of the Special Summary Revision. The court raised concerns over their exclusion from the democratic process.

headline: Goa's Sand Dunes Threatened by Luxury Resorts
summary: Activists have raised alarm bells as luxury resort projects threaten Goa's fragile coastal sand dunes. The developments could cause irreversible damage to the local ecosystem.

headline: Renting Ajay Devgn's Goa Villa Comes with Heavy Price Tag
summary: Bollywood actor Ajay Devgn's private villa in Goa is now open for holiday rentals. Staying a night at this premium luxury property will cost visitors a significant amount.

headline: Goan Voter Challenges Election Commission in Court
summary: A Goa resident has approached the court, accusing the Election Commission of forcing a false declaration to remain on the electoral roll. The voter argues that the commission's demands are unjust.

headline: AAP Demands Clarity on 'Goa First' Alliance
summary: Ahead of the 2027 elections, AAP has urged its alliance partner, the Goa Forward Party, to clarify its position amidst rumors of attempts to break the coalition.

headline: Footpath Encroachment Near Panaji Ferry Wharf Flagged
summary: Daily commuters have voiced anger over the illegal encroachment of footpaths near the busy Panaji ferry wharf. The blockage is forcing pedestrians to walk on the dangerous main road.

headline: ICAR-CCARI to Revive Goa's Traditional Bamboo Craft
summary: The ICAR-Central Coastal Agricultural Research Institute is working on an initiative to revive Goa’s fading traditional bamboo craft. The program aims to train local artisans in modern techniques.

headline: KTC Staff Demand Police Action After Assault Attempt
summary: Kadamba Transport Corporation employees have approached the police following an attempted assault on staff at the Valpoi bus stand. They are demanding enhanced security for transport workers.

headline: Highly Medicinal Narakya Shrub Destroyed in Sattari
summary: Environmentalists have expressed concern after the rare and highly medicinal Narakya shrub was uprooted in Sattari. The plant is crucial for various traditional remedies.

headline: Absence of Garbage Bins Plagues Benaulim-Colva Coast
summary: A complete lack of trash bins along the popular beach stretch from Benaulim to Colva has led to littering concerns. Visitors and locals have urged local bodies to take immediate action.

headline: Panchayat to Stop Industrial Yard Work in Old Goa
summary: The Old Goa panchayat has decided to issue a stop-work order to an industrial yard operating inside a residential zone. Residents had raised strong objections regarding safety and noise pollution.

headline: Pilerne Plant to Resolve Reis Magos Water Woes
summary: Residents of Reis Magos are set to receive a more consistent water supply once the new Pilerne treatment plant becomes operational. The project aims to resolve long-standing water shortages.

headline: Rights Panel Demands Action Against Illegal Rentals
summary: The Goa Human Rights Commission has ordered a crackdown on unauthorized commercial tourist rentals operating within a residential society in Calangute. The panel highlighted security issues faced by permanent residents.

headline: Nine Goa ITI Students Top National Trade Test
summary: In a remarkable achievement, nine students from a single Industrial Training Institute in Goa have secured top ranks in the All-India Trade Test. The achievement has brought immense pride to the state's technical education sector.

headline: High Court Slams EC Over Removal of Citizens
summary: The Goa bench of the Bombay High Court strongly criticized the Election Commission for removing citizens from the Special Summary Revision list. The court questioned the very purpose of the exercise if genuine voters are excluded.

headline: Festive Season Brings Flight Rescheduling and Rising Fares
summary: Travelers planning visits to Goa during the upcoming festive season will face higher airfares and rescheduled flight timings. However, airlines have also introduced more flights to handle the heavy rush.

headline: Nursing Seats Packed After Relaxation in Criteria
summary: Almost all nursing college seats in Goa have been filled up after the state government decided to relax the admission criteria. The move has provided relief to several aspiring healthcare students.

headline: Moira Villa Construction Continues Defying Stop Work Order
summary: Despite an official stop-work order and inspection by authorities, unauthorized construction work at a villa in Moira reportedly continues. Concerned villagers have demanded stricter enforcement.

headline: SWR Coal Freight Surge Spotlights Mormugao Port
summary: A sudden surge in coal freight transport by the South Western Railway has drawn fresh attention to Mormugao Port's handling capacity. The situation has reignited environmental concerns among local groups.

headline: BJP Accused of Blocking Public Access to Toyyar Lake
summary: Local residents and environmental activists have accused BJP members of illegally blocking public access to Toyyar lake. They are demanding immediate intervention from local authorities to restore the pathway.

headline: Tourist Dies in Fatal Car-Bike Collision in Mapusa
summary: A tourist lost their life in Mapusa after a car collided with their two-wheeler. Local police have initiated an investigation into the fatal road accident.

headline: Bicholim Walkway Lit Up Again
summary: Streetlights along the popular Bicholim walkway have been successfully restored by local authorities. The move has brought relief to regular evening walkers who complained of safety issues in the dark.

headline: Congress Yatra Enters South Goa Highlighting Unemployment
summary: The Congress party's ongoing foot march entered South Goa, where leader Yuri Alemao highlighted the severe job crisis in Shiroda. He urged the government to address the rising unemployment rates.

headline: Mormugao Flyovers Flagged as High-Risk Zones
summary: Mormugao's flyovers have turned into dangerous zones due to non-functional streetlights and inadequate safety barriers. Motorists have requested urgent maintenance to prevent fatal accidents.

headline: Paliem Farmers Cultivate Marigolds on Fallow Lands
summary: Farmers in Paliem have successfully brought barren, fallow agricultural lands back to life by cultivating marigolds. The initiative has helped them generate a profitable source of alternative income.

headline: Dudhsagar Falls Opens to Tourists with Enhanced Safety
summary: The scenic Dudhsagar waterfalls has officially reopened for visitors with strict safety measures. Jeep and tour operators have been directed to deploy personnel to ensure tourist safety.

headline: Goa to Extend Disability Survey State-Wide
summary: Following successful pilot projects in Sanguem and Bicholim, the state government is expanding its comprehensive disability survey across Goa. The data will help frame better welfare policies.

headline: Khaunte Asks Students to Focus on Practical Solutions
summary: IT Minister Rohan Khaunte has urged Goan students to transform their academic ideas into viable, real-world tech solutions. He emphasized the government's support for local youth startups.

headline: Goa Leverages Assistive Tech to Promote Inclusion
summary: Goa is exploring the integration of assistive technologies to foster greater social inclusion for individuals with disabilities. Local experts emphasize the role of digital accessibility.

headline: A Tale of Two Continents
summary: A special feature explores the shared history, culture, and deep-rooted connections between Goa and other parts of the world across two continents.

headline: Sattari's Sacred Groves Highlighted in School Lecture
summary: A government higher secondary school hosted a special lecture focused on the ecological and cultural significance of Sattari's sacred groves. The session aimed to inspire conservation efforts among students.

headline: Key Lessons from the Political Journey of RGP
summary: A retrospective analysis details the quick rise and subsequent decline of the Revolutionary Goans Party in the state. The study offers valuable lessons on regional politics and voter behavior.

headline: Encroachment on Mandovi Riverfront Sparks Public Outcry
summary: Increasing commercial encroachment along the Mandovi riverfront has triggered concerns among local citizens regarding the loss of public spaces. Activists have called on town planners to halt unauthorized activities.

headline: Sowell's Double Guides Ambelim SC to Victory
summary: A spectacular double strike from Sowell led Ambelim SC to an impressive victory in their latest football encounter. The performance cemented the team's strong position in the tournament.
